what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A decisions agent under a limited power of attorney signed with my key, a counsel agent drafting it, and a paid loop to a named person who answers for it.
sections.para: My key on my device; a limited, expiring delegation signed on pki.sgit.ai; every receiver checks the chain. Agents draft and test; only people and firms are accountable, so the loop ends in a quote, a signature and a payment. Updated 23 November: counsel.d and decisions.d running, draft v0.3, nothing signed.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: My decisions do not scale; a signed delegation; receivers check the chain; a power of attorney; a counsel agent; accountability; a quote; all proposed.

sections.label: The bottleneck is me
sections.line: Most decisions that wait for me are already well thought through, and each needs a visit to a session.
sections.para: The rule that agents act only on my word in their own session protects, and makes me the bottleneck.

sections.label: A decisions agent, and a delegation I sign
sections.line: My key on my device, a delegation I sign, a decisions agent issuing my verbatim answers, signed requests, receivers that check.
sections.para: Five links, what never travels under the delegation, and revocation on pki.sgit.ai.

sections.label: It is a power of attorney
sections.line: The design is a limited power of attorney: principal, attorney, instrument, scope, duties, revocation, registration, ratification.
sections.para: The ordinary power of attorney as the closest form, the lasting one as the model for registration, two research papers, and a powers section in each policy.

sections.label: A counsel agent
sections.line: A counsel agent drafts and simulates the instruments, requires several models' checks, and never gives legal advice.
sections.para: A certified mark only from a real, named legal service.

sections.label: Only people and companies can be accountable
sections.line: Agents can draft and check; only people and companies can be held accountable, and that is what a professional is paid for.
sections.para: With their experience, knowledge and their own optimised agents.

sections.label: The loop to a named person, and a price
sections.line: For any instrument: which person, which firm, which flow, what price, and pay, there and then.
sections.para: Agents draft; humans answer for it, recorded beside the instrument.

sections.label: Why this could scale law firms
sections.line: Arriving drafted, simulated and checked, a review becomes small and priced, so firms can serve far more of them.
sections.para: The same loop for accountants, auditors and security reviewers.

sections.label: Since this was first published
sections.line: I agreed it is a limited power of attorney and named counsel; counsel.d and decisions.d run; draft v0.3 awaits a security review.
sections.para: Since publication: two roles kept separate, eight failure cases simulated, and three changes in v0.3: scope by reversibility, one level of sub-delegation, suspension after 72 hours.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Nothing built; not legal advice; no firm involved; England and Wales sources; papers are proposals; a new key planned.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: maestro.d's decisions-at-scale and power-of-attorney analyses, memo 03, Which?, GOV.UK and two arXiv papers, 22 November 2026.
